semantics.schema: The unbound base schema remains SilverStar.ssdiag/1. Build entries may contain validated v1 ELF bindings or v2 strict ELF+HEX image bindings with the same target, diagnostic IDs and contract.
semantics.pending: No ELF hash or binding may be fabricated before a successful link and offline binding.
semantics.path: Automatic ELF paths are project-root-relative POSIX paths; traversal, drives, symlink escapes and missing files fail closed.
semantics.selection: Multiple bound outputs require an explicitly selected ELF; never select the newest or first Debug/Release output.
semantics.identity: Every embedded binding is checked against the actual ELF. A v2 entry also requires its explicitly named safe sibling HEX and the complete image contract, including erased alignment gaps. Live target flash verification remains mandatory before symbol reads.
semantics.maintenance: Optional expected protocol component/package/profile declaration, or null when disabled; absent means undeclared. Runtime capabilities remain authoritative. Descriptor version is not a maintenance protocol version.
semantics.project_file: Optional associated SilverStar.ssproject filename in the same root; data association only, never an instruction to load or execute code.
semantics.maintenance_uart: Optional maintenance.uart declares CubeMX-derived8N1 parameters: baudrate, data_bits, parity, stop_bits, v1 block_size512, block_deadline_ms30000, idle_timeout_ms30000 and minimum_wire_ms=ceil(8210000/baudrate). Legacy declarations remain valid; expected values do not prove bridge support or live identity. Actual generated UART/IOC must match at build; CAPS and selected rate must agree before transfer.
